2608.05817.title: M$^3$R-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Metaphor Understanding
2608.05817.paper_summary: Metaphor enables the understanding of abstract concepts through cross-domain mappings while conveying affective attitudes. In multimodal scenarios, visual and textual information jointly construct Target--Source mappings, requiring both conceptual understanding and cross-modal reasoning. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate metaphor understanding through isolated subtasks and lack evidence-grounded explanations, making it difficult to assess whether models establish mappings grounded in visual and textual cues.To address these limitations, we introduce M$^3$R-Bench, a unified and evidence-grounded benchmark containing 1,000 image--text instances with human-verified annotations. Guided by Conceptual Metaphor Theory and theories of nonliteral language understanding, M$^3$R-Bench provides joint annotations for metaphor occurrence, Target--Source mapping, sentiment, and stage-wise explanations following ``evidence identification--mapping establishment--sentiment inference.''Evaluations on M$^3$R-Bench reveal that existing models often overlook visual evidence, rely on superficial textual cues, and produce inaccurate Target--Source mappings, exposing a cross-modal evidence--mapping mismatch. To address this mismatch, we propose M$^3$R-Reasoner, which combines curriculum-based reasoning supervision with task-aware reinforcement learning to align model reasoning with metaphor interpretation. Experiments show that, with only an 8B-parameter backbone, M$^3$R-Reasoner outperforms larger proprietary MLLMs across four unified-task metrics and improves Visual Evidence and Sentiment Justification scores over GPT-5.5 by 28.45 and 30.11 points, respectively, while surpassing Claude-Sonnet-4.6 by 8.00 points in mean rubric score. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/hongshi4/M3R-Bench.
2608.05817.paper_summary_zh: 隱喻通過跨領域映射促進對抽象概念的理解，同時傳達情感態度。在多模態場景中，視覺和文本信息共同構建目標--來源映射，這需要概念理解和跨模態推理。然而，現有基準主要通過孤立的子任務來評估隱喻理解，並缺乏基於證據的解釋，使得評估模型是否建立基於視覺和文本線索的映射變得困難。為了解決這些限制，我們引入了 M$^3$R-Bench，一個統一且基於證據的基準，包含 1,000 個經人類驗證標註的圖像--文本實例。在概念隱喻理論和非字面語言理解理論的指導下，M$^3$R-Bench 提供了隱喻出現、目標--來源映射、情感和階段性解釋的聯合標註，遵循“證據識別--映射建立--情感推斷”。對 M$^3$R-Bench 的評估顯示，現有模型經常忽視視覺證據，依賴表面的文本線索，並產生不準確的目標--來源映射，暴露出跨模態證據--映射不匹配的問題。為了解決這一不匹配，我們提出了 M$^3$R-Reasoner，該模型結合了基於課程的推理監督和任務感知的強化學習，以使模型推理與隱喻解釋對齊。實驗顯示，僅用 8B 參數的主幹，M$^3$R-Reasoner 在四個統一任務指標上超越了更大的專有 MLLMs，並在視覺證據和情感合理性得分上分別提高了 28.45 和 30.11 分，相比之下，平均評分超過了 Claude-Sonnet-4.6 8.00 分。數據集和代碼可在 https://github.com/hongshi4/M3R-Bench 獲得。
